title: Rejection indicator bound
statement:
Let $\ell_x,\ell_y,\ell_x^0,\ell_y^0,q_z,q_z^x,q_z^0,q_z^{x,0}\in\mathbb F_2$. The indicator of the event $\ell_x^0\ell_y^0
e q_z^0+q_z^{x,0}$ is at most the indicator of $\ell_x\ell_y
e q_z+q_z^x$, plus the indicators of $\ell_x
e\ell_x^0$, $\ell_y
e\ell_y^0$, $q_z
e q_z^0$, and $q_z^x
e q_z^{x,0}$.
